SELECT
    sum(if(ScenarioKey = 1, Amount, 0))                                                        AS actual_sales,
    sum(if(ScenarioKey = 3, Amount, 0))                                                        AS forecast_sales,
    actual_sales - forecast_sales                                                              AS variance,
    (actual_sales - forecast_sales) * 100.0 / nullif(forecast_sales, 0)                       AS variance_pct
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan
WHERE
    AccountKey = 50
    AND toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4
    AND ScenarioKey IN (1, 3)
